summary: Scoped review of achievement-related Firestore rules: awards, pins, receipts, completions and reactions are server-owned; reads are restricted to the owner or family. Human chat sender and family identity remain immutable, text is bounded at 2000 characters, and senderName is now bounded at 120 characters on create and update, with matching client validation. This assessment excludes unchanged legacy rules and is supported by emulator checks rather than a blanket certification of the app.
